metadata.title: Rent a Bannerlord Co-op Server – Official Hosting
metadata.description: Official dedicated server hosting for Bannerlord Co-op, run by the mod team. Keep your multiplayer campaign online with daily backups and browser controls. {price}/month.
hero.heading: Rent a Bannerlord Co-op Server
hero.description: A dedicated server for your Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord co-op campaign, run by the team that makes the mod. We keep it online and backed up, so your group can join whenever you play.
hero.finePrint: Elite and Noble patrons get a server too.
included.heading: Everything your campaign needs
included.official.title: Built by the mod team
included.official.description: The only hosting made for Bannerlord Co-op by the developers who build it.
included.versions.title: Public or Nightly builds
included.versions.description: Run the Public release or the latest Nightly, and choose the version from the website.
included.backups.title: Automatic daily backups
included.backups.description: Campaign saves are backed up off the server every day.
included.control.title: Control it from your browser
included.control.description: Start and stop the server, set a password, switch campaigns, import saves, upload mods and use the server console.
included.managers.title: Share the admin work
included.managers.description: Give friends manager access so they can run the server while you're away.
included.support.title: Priority support
included.support.description: Patrons get priority help from the team.
regions.heading: Servers close to your group
regions.description: Choose a region when you create your server.
steps.heading: Three steps to your own server
steps.join.title: Join the Veteran tier on Patreon
steps.join.description: Subscribe for {price} a month. Elite and Noble memberships include a server too.
steps.connect.title: Sign in and connect Patreon
steps.connect.description: Sign in here on the website and connect your Patreon account so we can confirm your membership.
steps.play.title: Name it, pick a region, play
steps.play.description: Choose a name and region, set a game password and share the connection details with your friends. Import an existing save or start a new campaign.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.different.question: How is this different from regular Bannerlord server hosting?
faq.different.answer: General Bannerlord hosting is set up for the game's standard multiplayer. Ours runs the Bannerlord Co-op campaign server and is maintained by the team that develops the mod.
faq.selfHost.question: Can I host Bannerlord Co-op myself?
faq.selfHost.answer: Yes. The mod is free and you can host a campaign yourself. Renting a server saves you running a machine, keeping it online, updating it and backing it up.
faq.friends.question: Do my friends need to pay?
faq.friends.answer: No. Only the server owner needs a qualifying Patreon membership. Friends need the mod installed at the same version as your server, and your membership lets you share Nightly access with up to 10 friends.
faq.saves.question: Can I bring my existing campaign?
faq.saves.answer: Yes. Import a save from the website, or start a new campaign on the server.
faq.mods.question: Can I add other mods?
faq.mods.answer: Yes. Upload mods to your server from its page on the website.
cta.heading: Ready to start your campaign?
cta.description: Get a server through the Veteran tier on Patreon, then set it up here on the website.
